title: Telemetry Ribbons & Token Scalars: Responsive Console Component Prototype
creator: Maya Thompson
project: Console Design System: Metrics & Cost UX
description:
Goal: Create a reusable 'Telemetry Ribbon' component family and accompanying 'token scalar' mapping to unify compact metric strips across the Console. The ribbon should address density variants (compact / default / spacious), surface-aware theming (light/dark/contrast), and surface-level affordances for rollouts (canary / stable / deprecated). This ticket covers the high-fidelity Figma prototype, accessibility pass, developer handoff tokens, and a short spec for rollout states and animation timing.

Scope: prototype one metric ribbon (cost, latency, tokens) with three density tokens; define 8 new tokens (ribbon-padding, ribbon-gap, ribbon-elevation, ribbon-accent, ribbon-muted, ribbon-action, ribbon-focus, ribbon-motion-duration). Deliverables: Figma prototype, token table, spec doc, and a micro-interaction brief for engineering.

Out of scope: full dashboard migration, backend telemetry schema changes, dedicated autoscaling UI work (handled in ENG-4120).
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype includes density switcher (compact/default/spacious) and theme toggle; visuals match token values
Token table published in Confluence + copy/paste-ready JSON for engineers
Accessibility: contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for text chips; keyboard focus visible and motion-reduced variant included
Developer handoff with component variants and labels; at least one PR opened referencing this ticket
Rollout states defined with visual treatment and brief for Console Rollouts team
comments: 2025-01-18 - Maya Thompson: Initial ticket created after kickoff with PM and Eng. Summary of goals and token candidates attached. Asked Eng to confirm whether ribbon elevation should map to z-index or shadow token.
2025-01-21 - Rohan Patel (Eng): Confirmed shadow-based elevation aligns with runtime theming; ENG-4120 will expose a runtime CSS var for elevation. Added as dependency.

2025-01-24 - Grace Liu: Uploaded first-pass Figma screens. Called out two animation options: 'slide-in micro' (60ms) and 'fade-and-scale' (120ms). Prefers slide-in for compact lanes. Requested accessibility pass for motion-reduced users.

2025-01-27 - PM Lead (Anika Sharma): Noted rollout states must include a 'degraded' visual for when a metric is stale. Added acceptance criteria item. Suggested linking to cost-explorer tickets for migration planning.

2025-01-29 - Design Review (team): Feedback: simplify ribbon chip states, favor color-neutral borders for muted chips, increase tappable size to 44px on mobile variants. Action: update tokens and prototype.

2025-02-01 - Grace Liu: Updated token table and posted JSON in Confluence. Opened PR #2742 for base CSS variables and component scaffolding. Pushed new Figma file with motion-reduced option and annotated variants.

2025-02-02 - Accessibility review (Jin Park): Passed contrast checks; recommended explicit focus outline and ARIA role 'region' with label for ribbon groups. Motion reduction verified. Marked note for QA tests.
notes_decisions: Decisions: use shadow-based elevation token (ribbon-elevation) mapped to runtime CSS var; adopt 'slide-in micro' as default motion with 'prefers-reduced-motion' override; rollouts will be indicated with a small left accent stroke and a tooltip that explains state (canary/stable/deprecated). Implementation will use accessible chip semantics and follow existing Console button sizing for touch targets.
next_steps: 1) Finalize token names and publish to token library (Grace). 2) Eng to merge PR #2742 and expose runtime vars (Rohan). 3) QA to add contrast and keyboard testcases (Jin). 4) PM to schedule migration of one dashboard (cost-explorer) as pilot in the next cycle.
